title: Featured Projects
subtitle: A closer look at the enterprise platforms I've built and shipped in production, from AEM authoring experiences to cloud-scale asset pipelines.

items.title: O'Reilly
items.summary: Building scalable digital-asset and content workflows for a global learning platform, bridging AEM authoring with Google Cloud Storage at scale.
items.description: O'Reilly is a digital learning and publishing platform that provides a wide range of technical books, online courses, videos, learning resources, and digital content for technology professionals. The project involves developing and managing digital experiences using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) along with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for scalable content and digital asset management. The work includes managing AEM content and assets, integrating cloud-based storage solutions, supporting bulk asset processing and migration workflows, and implementing efficient content and asset management capabilities. The project also focuses on leveraging Google Cloud Storage (GCS) and serverless cloud services to handle large volumes of digital assets, improve scalability, and streamline content processing workflows between AEM and cloud environments.
responsibilities: Working on AEM development and content management for building and maintaining reusable components, templates, dialogs, and authoring features.
Developing and customizing AEM components, Sling Models, OSGi services, and Sling Servlets based on project requirements.
Working with AEM Assets/DAM for digital asset management, metadata handling, asset organization, and content workflows.
Working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for cloud-based storage and management of digital assets.
Developed AEM Hybrid Components using React to integrate modern frontend experiences with AEM authoring.
Working with Google Cloud Storage (GCS) for uploading, storing, and managing large volumes of digital assets.
Implemented a serverless approach for duplicate asset detection using cloud-based functionality and object hashing, reducing the need for external backend processing.
Working on bulk asset upload and import/export workflows to support large-scale content and asset migration.
Exploring and implementing metadata management and asset search capabilities across AEM and cloud storage.
Working on integration between AEM and Google Cloud services to support scalable asset management and content processing workflows.
Developing frontend functionality using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frontend technologies as required by the project.
Involved in analyzing technical requirements, designing solutions, development, debugging, and performance optimization.
Collaborating with team members and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable AEM and cloud-based solutions.
Worked on dynamic SEO and metadata requirements for AEM pages to support optimized page rendering and search engine visibility.
Working with Maven and Git for project build, source code management, and deployment activities.

items.title: HostelHub
items.summary: A live full-stack platform (hostelhub.online) to discover, compare and book verified hostels and PGs across India, with a complete control panel for hostel owners.
items.description: HostelHub (hostelhub.online) is a full-stack platform that helps students and working professionals discover, compare and book verified hostels and PGs across India. It also gives hostel owners a digital control room to run their property in real time — rooms and room types, bookings, rent and payments, staff, inventory, services and reports. The frontend is built with React 19, Vite, Redux Toolkit, React Router 7 and Tailwind CSS 4, and the backend is a separate Spring Boot 3 REST API with a MySQL database. Online payments are handled through Razorpay.
responsibilities: Designed and built the complete product end to end — frontend, backend, database and deployment — and run it live at hostelhub.online.
Built hostel discovery for users with search, filters by state and city, detailed hostel pages, wishlist and booking flow.
Integrated Razorpay for online payments, with checkout handling and a payment history view for users and owners.
Developed an owner/admin panel covering room and room-type management, bookings, users, staff, inventory, services, issues and payments.
Added dashboards and reports with charts (Recharts) so owners can track occupancy, revenue and activity at a glance.
Built user dashboards for bookings, payments, services, rewards, profile and settings.
Implemented forms and validation with Formik and Yup, including ID-proof upload with gallery and camera capture.
Managed global state with Redux Toolkit and API communication with Axios against the Spring Boot backend.
Built the backend REST APIs with Spring Boot 3 and MySQL for hostels, rooms, bookings, users and payments.
Added shared pagination, debounced search, an onboarding guide for owners, and an auto-generated sitemap for SEO.
